extDescription.message: Hear any tab in your language, spoken and subtitled in real time. Your own Gemini API key — no server in between.

panelStepKey.message: Interpretab needs your own Gemini key to translate. Get a free one at aistudio.google.com/apikey, then paste it into Options.
panelStepKey.description: First of the ordered next-step banners: shown until a key is saved. <a1> is AI Studio, <a2> opens this extension's Options page.

panelStepDirection.message: Nothing is switched on yet. Turn on Tab audio, Microphone, or both.
panelStepDirection.description: Next-step banner shown once a key is saved and neither direction is on, which is also when Start is disabled. The two bold names are the headings of the panel's two sections.

panelStepMic.message: Chrome has to let Interpretab use your microphone. You allow that once, in <a1>Options</a1>.
panelStepMic.description: Next-step banner shown when the microphone direction is on and Chrome has not granted the microphone. <a1> opens this extension's Options page at its Microphone section — a side panel cannot show the permission prompt itself.

panelRunningOn.message: Interpretab is running on “{1}”, and it runs on one tab at a time. Its controls are on that tab — Stop works from here.
panelRunningOn.description: {1} is the title of the tab the run is on.

panelRunningElsewhere.message: Interpretab is running on another tab, and it runs on one tab at a time. Its controls are on that tab — Stop works from here.
panelRunningElsewhere.description: The same as panelRunningOn, for when the tab's title could not be read.

panelTabDirection.message: Tab audio — this tab, into your language

panelInto.description: Reads as a sentence with the language dropdown after it: 'into [Japanese]'.

panelSourceDetected.description: Follows the target language dropdown. The language being translated from is not chosen by the user.

panelDuckLevel.description: Slider: how loud the tab's own sound stays while the translated voice is speaking over it.

panelMicDirection.message: Microphone — what is said in the room, translated out loud

panelMicNoteMuted.message: The translated voice is muted. Press the unmute button to hear it through your speakers.
panelMicNoteMuted.description: Prefixes panelMicNoteSimul while the sound button is off.

panelMicNoteSimul.message: Wear headphones for this one. It starts translating while you are still speaking, so it cannot switch your microphone off while it talks — through a speaker it hears its own voice, starts translating that too, and the translation gets worse.

panelMicNoteConversation.message: For two people sharing one microphone: it hears one of your two languages and speaks the other, out loud through your speakers, which is the point of this mode. Keep the microphone away from the speakers, or it will hear itself. It waits until each person has finished talking, so it is a little slower than Simultaneous — and it is the only mode that uses the glossary.

panelCostNote.message: Running both at once is two translations at once, so Google charges about twice as much.

panelUsagePaid.message: {1} so far, {2} of Gemini usage this run — an estimate, not your actual bill.
panelUsagePaid.description: {1} is how long the run has been going, {2} a rough cost. The closing disclaimer is not optional: a figure in dollars reads as a bill without it.

panelUsageFree.message: {1} so far, {2} of Gemini audio. Google charges nothing for this on the free plan.
panelUsageFree.description: {1} is how long the run has been going, {2} the audio it has moved. Must contain no price: the free tier is charged nothing.

panelUsageTip.message: Started {1} ago. Since then it has sent {2} of audio to Google and got {3} back, and both are charged for.
panelUsageTip.description: Tooltip on the usage line. {1} elapsed, {2} audio sent, {3} audio received.

panelUsageTipPaid.message: The figure uses Google's published prices as they stood in August 2026, not anything read from your account, and prices change. Your real bill only ever exists in your Google account.

panelUsageTipFree.message: Your key is set to Free on the Options page, and Google charges nothing on the free plan, so there is no cost to show. If the key's Google account has a payment method on it, set the plan to Paid there and this line will estimate what the run costs.

durationSeconds.description: A duration under a minute. {1} is a whole number of seconds.

durationMinutes.description: A duration of a minute or more, rounded. {1} is a whole number of minutes.

panelMuteOffElsewhere.message: The run is on another tab.
panelMuteOffElsewhere.description: Why a mute button is greyed out.

panelLangPopular.description: Heading for the first group of a language dropdown.

panelDirTab.description: Names the tab-audio direction inside panelHeard and panelTranslated.

panelHeard.description: Tag on a transcript line carrying what was said. {1} is panelDirTab or panelDirMic.

panelTranslated.description: Tag on a transcript line carrying the translation. {1} is panelDirTab or panelDirMic.

panelCaptionsUnavailable.message: Subtitles can't be shown on this page.

optSetupHeading.description: Group label over the three settings a first run needs: the key, the plan, and Chrome's microphone permission. It labels the section headings under it rather than a control of its own.

optSetupNote.message: Nothing works without the key. The other two you answer once, at the same time: which plan your key is on, and — only if you want your own voice translated — permission to use the microphone.

optRestHeading.description: Group label over the rest of the page — the settings that already have a working default.

optRestNote.message: These are all set to something that works. Come back and change one if it turns out not to suit you.

optKeyNote.message: Interpretab has no server of its own: your audio goes straight from this browser to Google, using your own key — get a free one at <a1>aistudio.google.com/apikey</a1>. The key is kept in this browser and is sent to nobody but Google. Whatever you use is billed to the Google account the key came from, so treat it like a password: don't share it, and don't paste it anywhere else. If it ever gets out, delete it on the <a2>page you made it on</a2> and paste a new one in here.
optKeyNote.description: Both links go to AI Studio's key page.

optKeyPlaceholder.description: Deliberately names no key format: Google has issued two, and a hint for one tells holders of the other to look for something they do not have.

optKeyNone.message: No key yet. Interpretab cannot start without one.

optKeyStray.message: Saved, but that does not look like a key. Did something else get pasted in?

optKeyShort.message: Saved, but that looks too short — is some of the key missing?

optPlanNote.message: Google does not tell Interpretab whether your key is free or paid, so please say which it is. On Free the side panel shows how long you have been translating; on Paid it also estimates what that has cost. A key is paid once the Google account it belongs to has a payment method on it — you can check yours at aistudio.google.com/apikey.

optPlanFree.message: Free — Google charges nothing for this key

optPlanPaid.message: Paid — pay as you go, billed to your account

optVoiceNote.message: The voice the translation is spoken in. It cannot change while a translation is running, so a new one is used the next time you press Start.

optVoiceOption.description: One entry in the voice dropdown. {1} is Google's name for the voice, which is not translated; {2} is one of the voice* words below.

optSizeNote.message: How big the subtitles on the page are. This applies straight away, even while a translation is running — drag it as you watch and stop where it reads well.

optSizePreview.message: The quick brown fox — 素早い茶色の狐
optSizePreview.description: Sample text under the size slider. Should show both a Latin and a CJK line if the language has one, since the two set at different heights.

optMicNote.message: Only needed if you want your own voice translated, and only the first time. Chrome will not show its permission window over the side panel, so the button is here instead — and what you allow here covers the whole of Interpretab.
optMicNote.description: Under the Microphone access heading. The condition comes first because this section sits in the group a first run is told to work through, and it is the one entry there that not everybody needs.

optMicBlocked.message: Chrome is blocking the microphone. Open Chrome's microphone settings, take Interpretab off the blocked list, and come back here.
optMicBlocked.description: Shown instead of optMicNotGranted once the permission state is 'denied', which the Allow button can no longer change: Chrome does not prompt a second time.

optMicDenied.message: Chrome did not allow the microphone ({1}).

optInputNote.message: Which microphone Microphone listens to. Left on the system default, your computer picks — and it sometimes picks one you never speak into, such as a monitor or a headset you have unplugged. Nothing looks wrong when that happens: the panel goes green, you talk, and nothing is ever translated. Pick the right microphone here if that happens. Applies the next time you press Start.

optInputSystem.message: System default — whichever microphone your computer is using

optInputAnonymous.description: A device whose name Chrome withholds until the microphone is granted. {1} is the start of its id.

optInputMissing.message: That microphone is not connected, so the system default will be used.

optInputSaved.message: Saved. Applies the next time you press Start.

optInputCleared.message: Saved. The system default microphone will be used.

optOutputNote.message: Where the voice from Microphone is played. The one from Tab audio always comes out of your usual speakers, since that is what you are listening to. Applies the next time you press Start.

optOutputSystem.message: System default — the speakers you are using

optOutputMissing.message: That device is not connected, so the speakers will be used instead.

optOutputSaved.message: Saved. Applies the next time you press Start — and whichever app should hear this voice has to be set to listen to that device too.

optOutputCleared.message: Saved. The translated voice will play on the speakers.

optDeviceListFailed.message: Could not see your audio devices ({1}).

optDeviceNamesHidden.message: Allow the microphone above to see the device names.

optDeviceSavedMissing.message: Saved device — not connected right now

optGlossaryNote.message: Names and terms you want said and spelled a particular way — products, people, jargon. One per line, as source,pronunciation,transcript: the second column is how it should be said, and the optional third is how it should be written in the subtitles. It works with the microphone in Two-way conversation mode only — the faster translation used everywhere else has nowhere to put a glossary.
optGlossaryNote.description: The <code> content is a CSV header and must not be translated.

optGlossaryTooBig.message: That file is too big — the limit is {1} bytes.

optGlossaryReplaced.message: Replaced with {1} entries. Applies on next Start.

errNoKey.message: No Gemini API key yet. Open Options and paste one from aistudio.google.com/apikey.

errPreflightNoKey.message: No Gemini API key. Add one in Options.

errKeyRejected.message: Gemini rejected that API key. Check it on the Options page, or make a new one at aistudio.google.com/apikey.

errQuota.message: That key has used up what Google allows for now. Wait for the limit to reset and press Start again, or add a payment method to move off the free plan — the free one runs out first.

errKeyForbidden.message: That key is not allowed to use the Gemini API. If you restricted the key, check that Gemini is still on its list — or make a new key at aistudio.google.com/apikey.

errAlreadyRunningOn.message: Interpretab is already running on “{1}”, and it runs on one tab at a time. Press Stop first — the Stop button works from any tab.
errAlreadyRunningOn.description: {1} is the title of the tab the run is on.

errAlreadyRunningElsewhere.message: Interpretab is already running on another tab, and it runs on one tab at a time. Press Stop first — the Stop button works from any tab.

errNoDirection.message: Turn on Tab audio or Microphone first.

errNoTab.message: There is no tab to listen to.

errClickIcon.message: Click the Interpretab toolbar icon on the tab you want to translate, then press Start again. ({1})
errClickIcon.description: {1} is Chrome's own error text, which is not translated.

errNoStreamId.message: Chrome did not hand over this tab's audio. Press Start again.

errMicRefused.message: Interpretab was not allowed to use the microphone. Open its Options page, allow the microphone once, and try again.

captionsChromePage.message: Chrome's own pages can't take them. Open a website and click the toolbar icon there.

captionsClickIcon.message: Click the toolbar icon on that page.

captionsOpenSite.message: Open a website and click the toolbar icon there.

micNoSoundNamed.message: Nothing has been heard on the microphone since you pressed Start. It is listening to “{1}” — if that is not what you are speaking into, pick the right one under Audio input in Options and press Start again.
micNoSoundNamed.description: {1} is the device label the operating system reports.

micNoSoundDefault.message: Nothing has been heard on the microphone since you pressed Start. It is listening to your computer's default microphone — if that is not what you are speaking into, pick the right one under Audio input in Options and press Start again.

micDeviceMissing.message: The microphone chosen in Options is not available ({1}), so your system's default input is being used instead.

outputDeviceMissing.message: The audio output chosen in Options is not available ({1}), so your translated voice is coming out of the speakers instead. Pick another one in Options.

closeReasonGiven.description: {1} is the server's own reason, which arrives in English and is not translated.

closeReasonOpaqueHint.message: Could not reach Gemini, and a browser is never told why. {1}

closeReasonOpaque.message: Could not reach Gemini, and a browser is never told why. It is usually the key: missing, refused, or over its limit — which the free plan reaches first.

closeBeforeReady.message: The session was closed before it was ready.

hintKeyAccepted.message: Your key worked a moment ago, so this is Gemini or your network rather than the key.

loopGaveUp.message: {1} Interpretab stopped trying after {2} attempts in a row. Check your key on the Options page, and how much you have left in Google AI Studio — the free plan does not allow much. Press Start to try again.
loopGaveUp.description: {1} is whichever failure message came last; {2} is a number of attempts.

loopDropping.message: The connection to Gemini keeps dropping.

glossaryBadLine.message: Line {1} should be: the word, how to say it, and — if you want — how to write it.

glossaryMissingField.message: Line {1} is missing the word or how to say it.
